epics.title: Slice 1 — script package and text-only runtime
epics.description: A scenario written in YAML is loaded, validated and played in text by three people over a LAN against AI NPCs with a Game Master, from one laptop with one command. Proves the core loop before voice, 3D and scoring.

epics.title: Slice 2 — web lobby, session view and reconnect
epics.description: Browser lobby with consent and role assignment, text session view, minimal facilitator console, replay-from-seq reconnect.

epics.title: Slice 3 — voice over LiveKit
epics.description: LiveKit rooms, per-track STT with speaker attribution, NPC TTS bot tracks, latency instrumentation against the budget in ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.

epics.title: Slice 4 — 3D scene
epics.description: Babylon.js scene as a pure consumer of scene events, library levels, avatar selection, idle/speaking/action animations.

epics.title: Slice 5 — evaluator and reports
epics.description: Post-session rubric scoring with quoted evidence and confidence, facilitator moderation, participant and group reports with ASM-09 visibility.

stories.title: As a developer, I want a pnpm monorepo with TypeScript and Vitest, so that every package builds and tests with one command.

acs.text: `pnpm install && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck` succeed from a clean clone
packages import each other as @acr/<name> workspace links

stories.title: As the runtime, I want typed session events and a pure reducer, so that session state is always a projection of the event log.

acs.text: reduce() rejects out-of-order seq
visibleTranscript() returns only scenes the role participated in
pause, resume, scene entry/exit, injects and NPC updates are reflected in state

stories.title: As a scenario author, I want my YAML scenario folder loaded and validated, so that mistakes are reported before a session starts.

acs.text: loadScenario reads scenario.yaml, roles/*.yaml and script.yaml
a missing roles/ directory fails with one message naming the folder
validator errors on unknown participants and duplicate inject ids
validator warns on injects past the time box and objectives with no criteria
a JSON Schema is exported for editors

stories.title: As the runtime, I want a scene state machine, so that scenes exit on time box, facilitator advance or a Game Master verdict.

acs.text: evaluateExit honours only the conditions a scene lists
dueInjects returns timed injects once

stories.title: As the runtime, I want a ModelProvider adapter with a mock and an Anthropic implementation, so that NPCs run in tests without a key and with a real model in play.

acs.text: the contract suite passes for the mock and (with a key) for Anthropic
MockModelProvider replays scripted replies and records calls
no file outside packages/adapters imports a provider SDK (lint)

stories.title: As a facilitator, I want a session engine that runs the script, so that scenes advance, injects fire and every turn is logged.

acs.text: start() enters the first scene and fires its opening inject
say() is refused while paused or when the role is not in the scene
timed injects fire once on tick
scenes exit on time box, advance or GM verdict and the session ends after the last scene
events persist to a JSONL log with monotonic seq

stories.title: As a participant, I want NPCs to reply in character, so that the role-play feels real.

acs.text: the persona prefix is cacheable and contains goals, knowledge, guardrails and the scene goal
hidden facts and other roles' briefs never appear in NPC prompts
on timeout or empty reply the fallback line is spoken and the facilitator is alerted
NPCs stay silent while paused or outside their scene

stories.title: As a facilitator, I want the Game Master to detect scripted exit conditions, so that scenes move on when the team achieves the goal.

acs.text: the GM evaluates gm_detects conditions every N utterances, not per turn
a true verdict exits the scene in the same tick and is logged with reasoning
unparseable or false verdicts leave the scene running

stories.title: As a participant, I want to join a session over WebSocket with my role, so that I can play from any machine on the LAN.

acs.text: a second participant claiming a taken role is refused with role_taken
players receive only events for scenes and injects addressed to them; the facilitator receives everything
the facilitator can start the session and send commands; players cannot

stories.title: As a participant or facilitator, I want a terminal client, so that the slice is playable without a web UI.

acs.text: pnpm play joins as a role or as facilitator and renders events
facilitator slash-commands map to protocol messages

stories.title: As a scenario author, I want the Friday Escalation scenario to run end to end in a simulation test, so that the slice is proven against a real script.

acs.text: the scenario validates with no errors or warnings
a scripted play-through passes all three scenes and ends
NPC prompts never contain hidden facts or player private facts

stories.title: As a facilitator, I want to start the whole MVP with one command, so that a session can run from a laptop.

acs.text: ./run.sh --dev starts the runtime and three terminals can play
the Docker image builds and runs the runtime
CI runs typecheck, tests and the SDK-import check

stories.title: As a participant, I want to reconnect and receive the events I missed, so that a dropped connection does not lose the session.

acs.text: a client sending a last-seen seq receives the events after it

lessons.title: PlanVisualizer installs are additive; install only from the released main
lessons.rule:
Install PlanVisualizer only from a fresh clone of the released `main` branch, never from a local `develop` checkout. `install.sh` copies files but never deletes them, so installing over a different-version install leaves orphaned tools and tests that fail against the new version. When reinstalling, restore your own `AGENTS.md`, `plan-visualizer.config.json` and docs afterwards; the installer replaces a missing `AGENTS.md` with a 7-line stub and resets the config project name.
_Learned when a develop-era install (repository layer needing `proper-lockfile` and `better-sqlite3`) was overwritten by `main` v2.4.0 and 47 test suites failed on 189 leftover files._
